english.title: Trader engage in commercial practice which is a misleading action containing false information - Unfair Trading Regs 08

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a trader, engaged in a commercial practice which was a misleading action in that

(A)_[it contained false information and was therefore untruthful in relation to a matter in regulation 5(4) of the Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008, namely **(..SPECIFY MATTER..)]_
(B)_[its overall presentation deceived or was likely to deceive the average consumer in relation to a matter in regulation 5(4) of the Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008, namely **(..SPECIFY MATTER..)]_
(C)_[it concerned the marketing of a product which created confusion with the product, trade mark, trade name or distinguishing mark of a competitor]_

and it caused or was likely to have caused the average consumer to take a transactional decision he would not have taken otherwise
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations9 and 13 of the Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008 were repealed by the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 as of 6th April 2025. For offences committed on or after that date see H101715.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see regulation 14 of the Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008 For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
